_note: Risk overlay on the incident's runbooks. A runbook is prose plus one automatable flag; a plan needs to know which individual step is safe to run unattended and which needs a human in front of it. Every 'action' string below is a verbatim substring of the runbook's own body text -- a test asserts that, so this file can add structure but can never invent a step the runbook does not contain.

actions.action: identify the blocking session in pg_stat_activity
cancel the migration backend with pg_cancel_backend
set lock_timeout on the migration role

human_follow_up: Rebuilding the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY is a human decision
RB-01.escalate_because: Rebuilding the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY is a human decision

not_when: NOT effective when the change is a database migration that is still running
not for sessions blocked on a table lock
